card.name: Apostrophes and letters inside split names
card.fires_on: An apostrophe or single letter in the middle of a name or word that is broken up, such as the apostrophe in honu'ea or Mi'kmaq. Also letters inside spaced-out text like A D M I N I S T R A T I O N.

modes.label: Apostrophe in names
modes.description: An apostrophe inside a foreign or Hawaiian name, right before the rest of the word.
modes.example: Most importantly, honu<<'>>ea are endangered under the U.S.

modes.label: Letters in broken-up words
modes.description: A letter or syllable inside a word that is spaced out or split by odd breaks.
modes.example: D O S A G E A N D A D M INI S<< T>> R A T I O N A c

card.writes: Promotes odd short word pieces from several languages, which suggests it helps continue unusual spellings.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of oddly spelled or split words, especially after an apostrophe in a name.
